name: tool-listen
description: Ask a question about a sound file: audio.listen extracts the audio with ffmpeg and sends it to a model that accepts audio

settings.title: Аудио
settings.description: audio.listen extracts the sound from an audio or video file and asks the model on models.routes.listen. Pick a chat model that accepts audio, for example a Gemini or gpt-4o-audio-preview on OpenRouter. This is not speech-to-text: that route is stt.

fields.label: Model / route
fields.help: Empty = models.routes.listen. Override with a models.routes key or provider/model-id.

fields.label: Max length
fields.help: A longer file needs start and end, in seconds. The clip is sent as 16 kHz mono mp3.
